verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own docs say it receives and stores mail and can "easily forward physical items wherever you need them" from one of its 53 street addresses, which touches only the forwarding part of the story. Nothing in the evidence mentions packages specifically, which carriers are accepted, consolidation, or holding items for pickup. Missing for 10: explicit package acceptance from all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS), package consolidation, hold-for-pickup option, details on forwarding methods, independent corroboration.
